text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: "—And so, person to person, heart to heart, they form one great circle."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Kiseki wrote some real good stuff in this manga. Behind every great achievement lies a deep network of bonds—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, time for me to get in on the action too!

—Walking through the party venue.
It was packed with all sorts of guests invited by Forever Young.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo♪ Hey everyone!
You all enjoying the party?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yan-ko, there you are.
What's the big deal, throwing a party out of the blue like this?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Well, I was thinking, wouldn't it be hype to expand our circle?♪ Even going to the Academy every day, there're tons of girls and Trainers we don't know, right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh my. We were just having that exact conversation ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Because our backgrounds differ, the conversations are all the more lively.
...A fascinating gathering indeed.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Oh, fr?! That makes me so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Let's expand the circle even more! Connect more and make this party the best it can b—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Whoa there!?

text_block_list.name: Party Staff
text_block_list.text:
Attention please: a building-wide blackout has occurred.
We are investigating the cause, so please remain calm and wait!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: What a trial this is...! At this rate, the party will—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If restoration takes too long, chaos may break out.
Shall we wrap things up here?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—Nope, no way.
We are not ending it like this!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, wanna lend me a hand?
We can't just let the circle we worked so hard to build vanish into thin air!

A spotlight illuminates the stage in the venue.
Forever Young and the others had put together makeshift lights using their smartphones.
They hastily made their preparations, and just as they finished—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—Hold it right there, Ruler!
Give Desire back to us!
At Forever Young's words, the gaze of the flustered audience in the dark gathered in unison.

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's going on!?
Did some kind of play just start...!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Yan-ko-san!
I told you not to come... Why did you!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I wanted to save you!
I swear I'll pry you from the 'Ruler's' grasp!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I cannot hand Desire over.
I still have plenty of uses for this dear 'Saint', after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
'Innovator', you say? What a joke.
There is no light to spark an innovation here!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: —! It's pitch black again.........

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Is there really nothing we can do about this situation...
Forever Young's shoes tap twice against the floor—tap, tap. That was the cue.
choice_data_list: (This is my cue to shine the smartphone light...)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ! ...Somehow, there's light—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...It's warm. Could this be the light of someone's heartfelt wishes?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: But it's still not enough... Just a little more—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Please, everyone in the world! Lend me your strength!

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text:
...That's it!
If we shine our phone lights at Yan-ko's feet—

text_block_list.name: Guest B
text_block_list.text: We can lend Yan-ko our power!!

text_block_list.name: Guest C
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do it too!!
Um, we just use our phone flashlights, right!
Beams of light gather around Forever Young—illuminating her path forward.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...So much light! —Now I can fight!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—Here I come, Ruler!
The innovation starts right here, right now!!
After things settled down... I went over to tell her how impressed I was by her quick-witted play.
choice_data_list: That was a really fun play

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thanks♪
Though really, it's all thanks to Kiseki's manga.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Trainer-san. Kiseki-san sent me a manga she drew."

Victoire Pisa had mentioned it before.
It must be the same manga.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: The protagonist in the manga just goes around helping people relentlessly... and that keeps building new connections.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It turns into one huge circle—and becomes one huge power.
...Looking at that made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Isn't that totally us? ...I thought!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Being born into this world, meeting each other.
And connecting with everyone so deeply—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Brings something into the world that nobody's ever seen before! Right?♪
choice_data_list: Even though it was improvised, it was amazing

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Brings something into the world that nobody's ever seen before! Right?♪
choice_data_list: Even though it was improvised, it was amazing

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it wasn't just me this time.
It was those girls who inspired me to act, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks♪ But next time...
I'm gonna do something that'll knock your socks off even more♪
